title: 主工作区 · 标题木牌、Hero 场景、代码块与对话气泡

assertions.message: 主内容画布消费 --dsw-alias-bg-base 半透明纸面（随纸面浓度滑杆变化）
assertions.expression: (() => { const frame = document.querySelector('.mP3x-q_frame'); if (!frame) return false; const bg = getComputedStyle(frame).backgroundColor; const dark = document.body.hasAttribute('data-ds-dark-theme'); return dark ? bg === 'rgba(41, 35, 28, 0.84)' : bg === 'rgba(248, 248, 240, 0.4)'; })()

assertions.message: 标题木牌绶带具备真实盒子尺寸
assertions.expression: (() => { const nav = document.querySelector('header nav'); if (!nav) return false; const r = nav.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width >= 60 && r.height >= 24; })()

assertions.message: 对话气泡 Composer 保留非空纸纹与边框
assertions.expression: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-composer-card]'); if (!card) return false; const cs = getComputedStyle(card); return cs.backgroundImage.includes('data:image/svg+xml') && Number.parseFloat(cs.borderTopWidth) >= 1.5; })()

assertions.message: 发送键采用主题实色胶囊背景
assertions.expression: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('[data-composer-card] button[aria-label="发送"]'); if (!btn) return false; const bg = getComputedStyle(btn).backgroundColor; return bg !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && bg !== 'transparent'; })()
